assets.name: 핏빛 성배
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent PNG relic inventory icon for the cheerful fantasy game 세명이 오리라. INPUT ROLES: all three input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Image 1 sets small inventory readability; images 2 and 3 are the primary visual style, with VERY thick black contour, round squat cartoon shapes, bright flat colors and simple graphic highlight dabs. Create ONE original relic icon, not a sheet. Match the reference's minimal casual 2D sticker art. Uniform thick nearly black outline (approximately 2.5-3 percent of subject width), round joins, bold internal lines only where useful. Big uncomplicated shape, cheerful toy-like proportions, only two flat colors per material plus one small oval cream highlight. Limited palette of 6-8 fill colors. FLAT cel-shaped color patches, absolutely no gradients or rendered reflections or bevel shading. Graphic near-front view with a slight playful tilt if useful. No photorealism, no 3D render, no painterly facets, no elaborate filigree, no tiny inscriptions. Center object on a square canvas, comfortably filling 74 percent of canvas, all parts inside and at least 10 percent transparent edge margins. Actual transparent alpha background, no background color, no checkerboard, no card frame, no drop shadow, no text, no branding, no watermark. All seven icons in this set must share outline weight, visual simplicity, scale and upper-left cartoon highlights. SUBJECT for 핏빛 성배: A cute sacred GOLDEN CHALICE with a wide round bowl, very short chunky stem and broad simple oval foot. Bright butter-yellow gold with one orange shadow patch. Top opening visibly filled with flat rich crimson liquid. One large simple red teardrop-shaped jewel/emblem in the center of the bowl expresses lifesteal. A small ivory highlight dab. Keep only about seven large shapes. Warm gold and bright crimson identity. No dripping liquid, no blood splatter, no skull decoration.
